gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/presets/language/markdown/manifest.toml)

Checks every Markdown file against markdownlint with the shipped rule set.

## Why

Markdown that lints the same everywhere renders the same everywhere.

## What to do

Run gspot check --fix for the rules that fix themselves; read the rule name for the rest.

## Where it runs

- Preset: [the markdown preset](/reference/presets/markdown/)
- Stage: commit
- Level: all
- Tool: markdownlint-cli2

Turn it off for a path with a reason: `gspot ignore markdown/markdownlint --paths <glob> --reason "<why>"`.
